description: List the bookings on the connected traveller's account, newest first, with each one's current status. Poll this to learn whether a booking went through or changed: pass updated_since with the polled_at of your last call to see only what moved. Requires the traveller to connect their Tell & Go account. Status is one of pending_payment, processing, confirmed, cancelling, cancelled, completed, failed or unknown.

updated_since.description: ISO 8601 date-time: only bookings updated after it.

name: list_my_bookings

journey_id.description: Continuity handle to pass on your next Tell & Go tool call.

title: List the connected traveller's Tell & Go bookings
